annotations.title: Find events and what's on in Malaysia

description: What's on in Malaysia: events, shows, workshops, tastings and other experiences for a time window: today, tonight, tomorrow, this weekend, this week, or a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Filter by neighbourhood or city, a category word (e.g. 'live music', 'workshop', 'kids') and free-only. Dated events come first with start and end times; items marked `anytime: true` are ongoing venue experiences bookable on any day, not scheduled events. `dated_count` is the number of dated events in the window; 0 means Festiv has none, and the items returned are ongoing experiences. Each item has the venue, price and a link.

area.description: Neighbourhood or district name, e.g. 'Bangsar', 'KLCC', 'George Town'. A name Festiv does not know is refused, not guessed; a city or region word such as 'Penang' or 'Klang Valley' is read as a city.
area.title: Area

category.description: Category word to match, e.g. 'live music', 'comedy', 'kids', 'tasting'.
category.title: Category

city.description: City when no neighbourhood is known, e.g. 'Kuala Lumpur', 'Petaling Jaya', 'Penang'.
city.title: City

language.description: Reply language for summaries: en, ms (Malay) or zh (Chinese). Venue names stay in their original script.
language.title: Language

when.description: today | tonight | tomorrow | this_weekend | this_week | YYYY-MM-DD (default: next 7 days).
when.title: When

name: find_things_to_do
